column3: The optimizer was incorrectly deciding that the addition of two 18-digit BINARY data items could be done as a binary addition instead of a packed-decimal addition.
When using TRUNC(OPT), the compiler shouldn't assume that binary data items fit their decimal digit picture clauses
Rounding off to 33 decimal places happens for COBOL 5/6 programs. This results in different results from COBOL 4.2/prior release.
When the same program is compiled with COBOL V5.2, the binary field contains a positive value - which is incorrect.
